definitions.explanation: The visual-arts club at a Japanese school. Members typically practice drawing, painting, and crafts and exhibit work at school festivals.

examples.japanese: {美術部|びじゅつぶ}に{所属|しょぞく}している。
examples.english: I belong to the art club.

examples.japanese: {美術部|びじゅつぶ}の{作品|さくひん}が{文化祭|ぶんかさい}で{展示|てんじ}された。
examples.english: The art club's works were exhibited at the school festival.

examples.japanese: {美術部|びじゅつぶ}の{活動|かつどう}を{通|とお}じて、いろいろな{画材|がざい}の{使|つか}い{方|かた}を{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: Through art-club activities I learned how to use various art materials.

notes:
Compound of {美術|びじゅつ} (fine art) + {部|ぶ} (club). Refers most often to school-level art clubs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美術部|びじゅつぶ}に{入|はい}る: to join the art club
- {美術部|びじゅつぶ}の{部室|ぶしつ}: art-club room
- {美術部|びじゅつぶ}の{先輩|せんぱい}: senior member of the art club
- {美術部|びじゅつぶ}{展|てん}: art-club exhibition

RELATED WORDS:
- {写真部|しゃしんぶ}: photography club
- {書道部|しょどうぶ}: calligraphy club
- {漫研|まんけん}・{漫画|まんが}{研究|けんきゅう}{部|ぶ}: manga study club
